rules: Track B official inputs are exactly snapshot-candidate.json and the Evidence Package.
Portal results, business requests, provider requirements, estimates, verbal explanations, and chat-only information are not official assessment inputs.
Track B official output is exactly rankability-assessment.json.
Each assessment references exactly one snapshot_id.
Issued assessments are immutable and are never deleted.
Changed evaluations require a new assessment_id and archival of the prior assessment.
The same snapshot_id and identical Evidence Package must reproduce the same assessment; any divergence requires a recorded cause.
Every recommendation requires quantitative justification and an Evidence Reference.
Track B may request registration but does not modify this registry.
Assessment is COMPLETE only when snapshot_id, Evidence Package, Assessment Contract, and Registry traceability are all verified.
If completion conditions are not all satisfied, assessment_status remains INCOMPLETE.
If trigger conditions are incomplete, Track B uses only an official WAITING state and does not create a temporary or estimated assessment.
Track B operating rules are FINAL LOCKED at Directive v1.3.
